---
title: "Render all lectures"
output: html_document
---

Knit this file, or run its chunks, to render all lectures in this folder. Each deck is rendered in a fresh R session and written straight into `docs`, next to `source`, which is what GitHub Pages serves. Rendering stops at the first lecture that fails, and the error names it.

To render a single lecture, open it and press Knit: each lecture also writes its HTML into `docs`.

```{r render, message = TRUE}
# Rscript from a shell can start in the C locale, where plot labels lose
# non-ASCII characters (ΔC becomes <U+0394>C). Each document is rendered in a
# child R session that inherits these variables.
if (!l10n_info()[["UTF-8"]]) Sys.setenv(LANG = "en_US.UTF-8", LC_ALL = "en_US.UTF-8")
docs <- normalizePath(file.path("..", "docs"))
lectures <- list.files(pattern = "^[0-9]{2}_.*\\.Rmd$")
for (lecture in lectures) {
  message("Rendering ", lecture)
  xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render, list(input = lecture, output_dir = docs, quiet = TRUE))
}
```

```{r rendered}
html <- file.path(docs, sub("\\.Rmd$", ".html", lectures))
knitr::kable(data.frame(deck = basename(html), updated = format(file.mtime(html), "%d %b %Y %H:%M")))
```
